paper.title: Brain-Gut-Microbiota Axis in Alzheimer’s Disease
paper.summary: 이 논문은 알츠하이머병에서 뇌-복잡-미생물 축에 대한 핵심 기여를 제시하는데, 이를 통해 알츠하이머병의 병태생을 이해하고 새로운 치료 방안을 개발할 수 있을 것이다.

paper.title: The Gut Microbiome Alterations and Inflammation-Driven Pathogenesis of Alzheimer’s Disease—a Critical Review
paper.summary: 이 논문은 알츠하이머병의 병태생물학적 기전에서 소화기 미생물 변동과 염증이 주요 원인임을 강조하는 것.

paper.title: Neuromodulation of Thought: Flexibilities and Vulnerabilities in Prefrontal Cortical Network Synapses
paper.summary: 이 논문은 프레프론탈 코르텍스 네트워크의 신경모듈레이션을 통해 생각의 유연성과 취약성을 규명하는 주요 기여를 제공합니다.

paper.title: Discovery of a dual-action small molecule that improves neuropathological features of Alzheimer’s disease mice
paper.summary: Since Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a multifaceted neurodegenerative disease, multitargeted therapeutic approaches are likely required for effective AD treatment. The importance of acid sphingomyelinase (ASM) activation in the various neuropathological features of AD is well-known.

paper.title: Microbiota-derived short chain fatty acids modulate microglia and promote Aβ plaque deposition
paper.summary: Previous studies have identified a crucial role of the gut microbiome in modifying Alzheimer’s disease (AD) progression. However, the mechanisms of microbiome–brain interaction in AD were so far unknown.

paper.title: Clinical diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease: recommendations of the International Working Group
paper.summary: 이 논문은 알츠하이머병의 임상진단을 위한 국제 일제 그룹의 권고안을 제시하여, 진단 기준을 정립하고 의사들의 판단을 지원하는 데 기여한 것이다.

paper.title: Blood biomarkers for Alzheimer’s disease in clinical practice and trials
paper.summary: 이 논문은 알츠하이머병의 혈액バイオ마커를 임상실무와 실험에 적용하여 새로운 치료방안을 모색하는 데 있어 핵심적 기여를 했다.

paper.title: Advances in Biomaterials for Drug Delivery
paper.summary: Advances in biomaterials for drug delivery are enabling significant progress in biology and medicine. Multidisciplinary collaborations between physical scientists, engineers, biologists, and clinicians generate innovative strategies and materials to treat a range of diseases.

paper.title: Poly(Lactic Acid): Recent Stereochemical Advances and New Materials Engineering
paper.summary: Poly(lactic acid) (PLA) is a representative biobased and biodegradable aliphatic polyester and a front‐runner among sustainable materials. As a semicrystalline thermoplastic, PLA exhibits excellent mechanical and physical properties, attracting considerable attention in commodity and medical fields.

paper.title: Engineering Macrophages for Cancer Immunotherapy and Drug Delivery
paper.summary: Macrophages play an important role in cancer development and metastasis. Proinflammatory M1 macrophages can phagocytose tumor cells, while anti‐inflammatory M2 macrophages such as tumor‐associated macrophages (TAMs) promote tumor growth and invasion.

paper.title: CSF biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease concord with amyloid‐β PET and predict clinical progression: A study of fully automated immunoassays in BioFINDER and ADNI cohorts
paper.summary: Introduction We studied whether fully automated Elecsys cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) immunoassay results were concordant with positron emission tomography (PET) and predicted clinical progression, even with cutoffs established in an independent cohort.

paper.title: Prediction of Longitudinal Cognitive Decline in Preclinical Alzheimer Disease Using Plasma Biomarkers
paper.summary: Alzheimer disease (AD) pathology starts with a prolonged phase of β-amyloid (Aβ) accumulation without symptoms. The duration of this phase differs greatly among individuals.

paper.title: Targeting Prodromal Alzheimer Disease With Avagacestat: A Randomized Clinical Trial
paper.summary: 이 논문은 알츠하이머병의 초기 단계인 프로드롬 단계를 대상으로 하여 아바가세스타트라는 약물을 사용한 randomized clinical trial을 수행하여, 이 약물의 효능을 확인하는 데 중점을 두었다.

paper.title: Safety, Efficacy, and Feasibility of Intranasal Insulin for the Treatment of Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimer Disease Dementia: A Randomized Clinical Trial
paper.summary: 이 논문은 중등급 인지장애와 알츠하이머병 치매에 대한 인삼내시린트라제의 안정성, 효능 및 실제성을 조사한 randomized clinical trial로, 이러한 질환의 새로운 치료 방안을 제안하고 있다.

paper.title: The Alzheimer's Association appropriate use recommendations for blood biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease
paper.summary: Blood‐based markers (BBMs) have recently shown promise to revolutionize the diagnostic and prognostic work‐up of Alzheimer's disease (AD), as well as to improve the design of interventional trials. Here we discuss in detail further research needed to be performed before widespread use of BBMs.

paper.title: Blood phosphorylated tau 181 as a biomarker for Alzheimer's disease: a diagnostic performance and prediction modelling study using data from four prospective cohorts
paper.summary: 이 논문은 4개의 예비집단에서 얻은 데이터를 사용하여 알츠하이머병의 진단 성능과 예측 모델링을 연구하여 혈액 중 phosphorylated tau 181을 새로운 바이오마커로 제안합니다.

paper.title: Efficiency, capacity, compensation, maintenance, plasticity: emerging concepts in cognitive reserve
paper.summary: 이 논문은 인지보호에 대한 새로운 개념 4가지를 제안하는데, 효율성, 용량, 보상, 유지 및 пластич성이 이를 구성하는 핵심 요소입니다

paper.title: Cognitive impairment in multiple sclerosis: clinical management, MRI, and therapeutic avenues
paper.summary: 이 논문은 다중 경화증에서认知 장애의 핵심적 기여를 제공하여, 임상 관리, MRI, 그리고 치료 방안을 통합적으로 살펴보는 데 중점을 두고 있습니다.

paper.title: Genome-wide CRISPR Screens in Primary Human T Cells Reveal Key Regulators of Immune Function
paper.summary: 이 논문은 인간 T 세포에서 CRISPR 스크린이 사용하여 면역 기능을 조절하는 핵심 요인을 규명한 것이다.

paper.title: The gut microbiome in Alzheimer’s disease: what we know and what remains to be explored
paper.summary: Alzheimer’s disease (AD), the most common cause of dementia, results in a sustained decline in cognition. There are currently few effective disease modifying therapies for AD, but insights into the mechanisms that mediate the onset and progression of disease may lead to new, effective therapeutic strategies.

paper.title: Current understanding of the Alzheimer’s disease-associated microbiome and therapeutic strategies
paper.summary: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a fatal progressive neurodegenerative disease. Despite tremendous research efforts to understand this complex disease, the exact pathophysiology of the disease is not completely clear.

paper.title: The Microbiota–Gut–Brain Axis and Alzheimer’s Disease: Neuroinflammation Is to Blame?
paper.summary: For years, it has been reported that Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is the most common cause of dementia. Various external and internal factors may contribute to the early onset of AD. This review highlights a contribution of the disturbances in the microbiota–gut–brain (MGB) axis to the development of AD.
